about: Every upstream ConfigOptions.lua switch, classified as a seasoned PoE 1 player would set it (solver config assumptions). Data only.

classes.source: On only when the build has one of `sources` keeping it up in normal play; then set `value` (true, a number, '=expr', or 'max' = leave empty so the engine uses the maximum). Source `modes` limits a source to mapping or bossing (kill-based sources are mapping only). kind ref = same sources as that key.
classes.playstyle: Value follows from the main skill's tags and the play mode: valueRule.cases, first case whose `when` tags all apply wins ([] = any build). Values: number, bool, 'max' (leave empty = the maximum), 'keep' (leave the default), '=expr' over engine output stats.
classes.defence: Follows the defence style: rule.on / rule.closeCall / rule.off are expressions over engine output stats (and other keys).
classes.never: Situational, boss-phase, debuff, debug or calculation-mode switch: leave at the default, never assumed unasked.
classes.enemy: Enemy or content description: the goal sets it.
classes.goal: Already owned by the goal or existing solver logic (bandit, pantheon, flasks, ailments, crit recently).
